arxiv-2210-17373.description: Abstract We characterize the assignment games which admit a population monotonic allocation scheme (PMAS) in terms of efficiently verifiable structural properties of the nonnegative matrix that induces the game. arxiv-2502-00461.description: Abstract This work explores the interplay between quantum information theory, algebraic geometry, and number theory, with a particular focus on multiqubit systems, their entanglement structure, and their classification via geometric embeddings. pmc-13087352.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Lymphoepithelioma-like carcinoma typically arises in the nasopharynx. Herein, we describe a case of an 82-year-old male presenting with a 2-year history of left-sided hearing loss, a 3-year history of left facial asymmetry (including mouth deviation and eyelid insufficiency), and a 10-day history of nausea/vomiting. His medical history included chronic otitis media.
